description: Demo readiness follow-up after the completed 10/10 DAM depth run. Three product-app slices close local role rehearsal truth, pending review evidence persistence, and public portal readiness diagnostics without weakening ResourceSpace/source-truth guardrails.
guardrails: Google Shared Drive remains master-original custody.
Product-app work only; no marketing landing page.
No source media deletion, rename, move, or mutation.
No fake assets, counts, approvals, metadata, AI tags, duplicate scans, public links, analytics, download success, or rendition truth.
No ResourceSpace internals exposed to normal users.
No credentials, paid service, production deploy, public publish, destructive migrations, or source-media mutation.

runModel.orchestrator: Owns source edits, validation, GitHub evidence, tracker updates, and checkpoints.
runModel.helpers: Read-only unless docs/tests are explicitly disjoint.
runModel.validation: Focused validation per issue: git diff --check, frontend typecheck, targeted tests when helper/source logic changes, one desktop/mobile browser proof when UI changes.

issues.title: Role rehearsal entry and truth labels
issues.notes: Implemented visible `/rehearsal` product-app entry surface using existing local role-switch mechanics. Viewer remains default when role switch is disabled; role copy labels rehearsal-only, not production auth or SSO; route cards continue to reflect backend access decisions. Updated local demo runbook to use visible role rehearsal path for Reviewer proof where possible.
validation: Playwright desktop/mobile proof at /rehearsal on port 4875

issues.title: Review evidence field persistence
issues.notes: Persisted separate review evidence-depth fields through review packet, API request body, pending review write records, audit response records, and UI payload. Existing base checklist/note requirements remain; missing depth fields now block API packets fail-closed. Pending-write copy still says ResourceSpace remains unchanged until sync confirms.
validation: npm --prefix frontend run test -- review-evidence-depth.test.ts review-evidence-packet.test.ts
Playwright desktop/mobile proof at /review on port 4875 with x-tjc-role: Reviewer

issues.title: Public portal readiness diagnostics
issues.notes: Added public portal readiness diagnostics for zero Portal Ready collections. Diagnostics count safe categories from existing export/backend fields: reviewer/date, rights/consent, people/minors, approved-copy derivative, usage scope, and publish state. Public page renders safe review-queue links without exposing ResourceSpace internals or inventing public link/share/download truth.
validation: Playwright desktop/mobile proof at /public-portal/sabbath on port 4875

issues.title: Final focused QA and evidence pack
issues.notes: Ran separate focused final QA after build issues #54-#56. Consolidated desktop/mobile proof for role rehearsal, review evidence persistence, and public portal readiness diagnostics. Wrote final runbook/known-limits note.
validation: npm --prefix frontend run test -- public-portal-preview.test.ts review-evidence-depth.test.ts review-evidence-packet.test.ts
Playwright desktop/mobile proof for /rehearsal, /review, and /public-portal/sabbath on port 4875
